## Quarto

Quarto enables you to weave together content and executable code into a finished document. To learn more about Quarto see <https://quarto.org>.

## Running Code

When you click the **Render** button a document will be generated that includes both content and the output of embedded code. You can embed code like this:

```{r}
1 + 1
```

You can add options to executable code like this

```{r}
#| echo: false
2 * 2
```

The `echo: false` option disables the printing of code (only output is displayed).

```{r}
10 + 20
```

```{r}
5*5
```

## Question 1: Visualize the relationship between students' majors (by category) and average weekly use of generative AI (in hours) using ggplot and a relevant graph/chart.


```{r}
# Code for question 1
ai_impact_data |> 
  group_by(Major_Category) |> 
  summarize(mean_hours = mean(Weekly_GenAI_Hours)) |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = mean_hours,
             y = Major_Category,
             fill = Major_Category)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  labs(x = "Average Weekly Hours",
       y = "",
       subtitle = "Average Hours of AI Use Weekly by Major Category")
  
         
```
